title: From Measurement Instruments to Data: Leveraging Theory-Driven Synthetic Training Data for Classifying Social Constructs
reasoning: The paper conducts a systematic evaluation of classification models on constructs that include 'traditional morality' and 'religious institutions' (from the Manifesto Project codebook) and 'sexism' (using survey scales). These religious, moral, and ethical social constructs are the core subjects of the benchmarking of their synthetic data generation methodology.
